governance_policies.mpn_display_rule: UI must display product_identifiers.mpn and must not display product_id in any user-facing surface. governance_policies.staging_authoritative: Staging is the single authoritative environment for Phase 2B; all evidence is captured directly from staging.
governance_policies.no_falsification: Do not invent or mock evidence. Real API responses, real E2E test runs, real accessibility audits required.
governance_policies.automated_evidence: All evidence must be machine-readable and reproducible. Manual screenshots acceptable only when supplementing automated checks.
